narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Times ten means add a zero, so five point seven zero.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But five point seven zero is still five point seven.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Adding a zero only works for whole numbers.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Count the zeroes in ten, one hundred or one thousand.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Move the point that many places to the right, and fill empty places with zeroes.

old_misconception.wrong_move: A common slip adds a zero at the end, writing five point seven times ten as five point seven zero. That is still five point seven, because end zeroes after the point add nothing.
